media: Use case: compositing. Asset type: transparent clothing overlay for an existing Vitruvian-man website drawing. Image 1 is the EXACT placement and pose guide, not artwork to include. Image 2 shows the garment style references. Output a SQUARE 1024x1024 transparent PNG with clothing ONLY, registered to exactly the same full-square coordinates as image 1. Do not crop to content or enlarge the clothes to fill the canvas. Match the guide's slim torso and its LOWER, HORIZONTAL pair of arms. Sleeves extend straight sideways from shoulders at (42%,34%) and (56%,34%) toward cuffs at (20%,34%) and (80%,34%). Leave the raised alternate pair of drawn arms uncovered. Use the OUTER spread pair of legs, not the straight central pair: legs fan out from crotch (50%,57%) toward left ankle (28%,87%) and right ankle (71%,87%). Shoes face outward toward image left and right. Front orthographic view, natural garment volume and folds around this invisible body. NO person, skin, hands, feet, drawing, circle, square, typography, labels, hat, accessory, floor, cast shadow, backdrop or mannequin in the output. All non-clothing pixels including the neck hole and gaps between garments must be true transparent alpha. Photographic fabric and leather textures. Outfit: the warm ochre brown chore jacket from image 2 with contrasting dark-brown collar, SMALL chest workwear tag, sleeves outstretched horizontally to the wrist anchors. Neck opening centered at (50%,31%), jacket torso occupies x42%-58% from y32% to y54%. Under it blue denim knee-length shorts with angled, spread leg openings at (39%,69%) and (61%,69%), fitted waist y52%. Red stitched cowboy boots follow the OUTER angled shins: shaft centers (33%,78%) and (66%,78%), ankle centers (28%,87%) and (71%,87%), toes (24%,89%) and (77%,89%). They are separated across the width with a large empty gap, never standing side by side in the middle. Keep everything strictly aligned to the supplied Vitruvian body. Two sleeves, two shorts legs and two boots.
